item.title: Whiskers 0.8.29
item.description:
What's New in 0.8.29

### Screen Context (Optional)

  • Added optional Screen Context for AI Enhancement, using text from your active window to better handle file names, symbols, and paths
  • Process Screen Context locally and send only extracted text to your AI provider, never a screenshot
  • Added onboarding and Settings controls to help you enable Screen Context when you want it

    • ### Improvements

  • Improved Screen Context text extraction to reduce noise for more reliable enhancement
  • Improved automatic update defaults so Whiskers checks daily by default without overriding preferences you’ve already changed
